candidates.description: This vector represents chemical and physical processes, elements, and energy interactions.
This vector represents words related to variety, distinction, completeness, and importance across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on tokens related to meteors, space phenomena, and atmospheric or celestial terms.
This vector represents common Spanish adjectives and qualitative descriptors expressing difficulty, importance, possibility, or general state.
This vector represents common Spanish nouns denoting general categories, aspects, parts, or abstract entities.
This vector represents structural, systemic, and categorical concepts across multiple languages, predominantly in Spanish.
This feature vector represents the Latin-derived root 'cum-' (meaning 'with' or 'together') and its common phonetic variations across various word fragments.
This vector activates on Latinate or mythological-sounding proper noun suffixes, particularly related to planets, deities, and classical nomenclature.
This vector represents word fragments and roots containing the letter sequence "br" or related phonetic variations across multiple languages.
This vector activates strongly on the character sequence 'cr' and words containing it.
